JSZip 3.10.1 — vendored, not a build step
Copied from the npm package `jszip@3.10.1` (MIT/GPLv3 dual licence), file dist/jszip.min.js, unmodified.
Used by razor-cut-tool.html for "Download all as .zip" and "Share all".
Vendored rather than loaded from cdnjs so a CDN outage cannot break the export, and so the tool keeps working offline.
